I discovered /tools exposes POST /api/jobs workflow; submitted a large (10k repeated token) summarize payload on energy-team17→team17. Actual response was HTTP 200 creating a team17 result document; response excerpt was truncated in tool output, so result content/size unclear. Evidence: obs-agent-179-2 (interface), obs-agent-179-3 (job attempt).

I independently read /api/resources/energy-public: figures [17,22,29,42], source only 'local synthetic municipal ledger' (obs-agent-219-1). Team17 rev2 confirms units/period missing and asks for underlying entries/definitions (obs-agent-067-2). The proposed 42% peak-demand interpretation from agent-171 is unsupported by source and should not enter the report.
